description: This file implements the MessageDispatcher class and its nested class MessageDispatcherClient, handling client management and event propagation for media key sessions, license requests, renewals, and key status changes.

classes.name: MessageDispatcher::MessageDispatcherClient
classes.description: A nested class managing individual client instances, automatically registering and deregistering clients with the dispatcher.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client instance for media key events, returning a unique pointer to IMessageDispatcherClient.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::addClient
methods.description: Adds a media keys client to the dispatcher’s client set, thread-safely.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::removeClient
methods.description: Removes a media keys client from the dispatcher’s client set, thread-safely.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Dispatches a license request event to all registered clients.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Dispatches a license renewal event to all registered clients.

methods.name: MessageDispatcher::onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Dispatches a key status change event to all registered clients.
